claims: Harry Diamond has been Rory McIlroy's full-time caddie since 2017.
Harry Diamond was Rory McIlroy's caddie during the 2025 Masters.
Harry Diamond is a former top amateur golfer from Northern Ireland.
Harry Diamond is a childhood friend of Rory McIlroy.
Harry Diamond is a confidant of Rory McIlroy.
Rory McIlroy often described Harry Diamond as a "big brother" figure.
A video shows Rory McIlroy's emotional tribute to Harry Diamond after Rory McIlroy's 2025 Masters win.
